scope: Bounded diagnosis only. No selector changes, new policy, cap/deadline changes, production integration, or mall bypass.
decision: Recommend one separately approved experiment: bounded residual-domain pair consistency with blocker explanations and conflict-directed backtracking.

unconditioned_pair.scope: static-valid pair without the seven selected blockers

conditional_obstruction.interpretation: The first seven assignments leave individually nonempty but jointly incompatible domains for hydrogen 13 and optical-grating crystal 18. No stone 22 assignment can repair this fixed prefix.
conditional_obstruction.oracle_scope: Expanded integer-cell geometry independently checks pair compatibility and owned endpoint sharing; static path and fixed-obstacle checks use the frozen implementation.

recommendation.change: When residual domains become small, test pair support within an explicit work bound. On a complete no-support proof, propagate the selected-blocker explanation and backtrack beyond assignments absent from that explanation.
recommendation.why: Per-domain forward checking misses this joint contradiction. The recorded 161 stone attempts and 9 hydrogen attempts retain the same already-infeasible seven-choice prefix.
recommendation.safety: A capped or incomplete pair check is unknown, never infeasible. Preserve existing templates, collision rules, limits, and factory acceptance gates. Do not hard-code obligation IDs or corridor geometry.
recommendation.acceptance_for_future_experiment: Detect this conditional contradiction without enumerating irrelevant stone assignments; validate explanations and restoration against finite exhaustive cases; then rerun the frozen control under unchanged limits. No claim of solving the control before that run.

alternatives_rejected.larger_pair_cache: Repeated pair misses consume only 0.51448% of the predicate budget.
alternatives_rejected.static_segment_memoization_first: Repeated static query work is material, but removing it would not eliminate this proven dead prefix; no whole-run speedup or success has been demonstrated.
alternatives_rejected.template_redesign_now: Conditional infeasibility does not establish template-family infeasibility. Candidates 13:0 and 18:1 coexist when the seven selected blockers are omitted.

claim_limits: No complete factory selection was produced.
No global template-family or factory infeasibility proof.
The compatible unconditioned pair is not a complete factory solution.
Graphene obligation 9 was interrupted, not proved individually infeasible.
No implementation or promotion decision made; mall and held-out gates remain unchanged.

reproduce.environment: Existing project Python 3.14 environment; run from project root with PYTHONPATH=src. Extract diagnostic reproduction.zip to a separate directory.
reproduce.checks: Both scripts exit 0; exact frozen outcome/work counters; 625 residual pairs, zero compatible; 42750 independent comparisons, zero disagreements.
